svg.aria-label: Two-phase commit: Ask everybody, decide once, tell everybody. And that is the problem.. ⟨PREPARE⟩; ⟨VOTE, yes⟩; ⟨VOTE, yes⟩; all yes: decide commit; ⟨DECISION, commit⟩; a crash here instead, and nobody can decide. A participant that voted yes cannot decide alone: the missing coordinator might have decided either way.
